AGENDA
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  NOVEMBER 13, 2019
STUDY SESSION MEETING
CITY HALL - U.S. CONSTITUTION ROOM/#4
7:00 P.M.

REGULAR MEETING
  7:30 PM
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Rosa Barragan, Chair
  Scott D. Collins, Vice Chair
  Kim Apodaca, Planning Commissioner
  Victor Juan, Planning Commissioner
  Linda Lopez, Planning Commissioner
  Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address Planning Commission on any matter listed on the agenda or on any
  other matter within its jurisdiction subject to the rules of decorum described in Section 2.08.020 of the Norwalk Municipal
  Code. If you wish to address Planning Commission, please complete the card that is provided at the rear entrance to
  Council Chambers and hand the card to the Secretary. Planning Commission will hear public comment on items listed on
  the agenda during discussion of the matter and prior to a vote. Planning Commission will hear public comment on matters
  not listed on the agenda during the Oral Communications period.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The Planning Commission may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule
  certain matters for consideration at a future Planning Commission meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Planning Commission:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the Planning Commission as a whole and not directed to individual Planning
  Commission members.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the Secretary's office, (562) 929-5744. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the Secretary if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Planning Commission regarding any item on this agenda
  after it has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e?mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

REGULAR MEETING
 CALL TO ORDER

FLAG SALUTE  Commissioner Apodaca

ROLL CALL OF MEMBERS

  1.  MEETING MINUTES - Staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve the minutes of the
  Regular Meeting of October 23, 2019.

  PC Minutes 10-23-19

PUBLIC HEARING

  2.  NOTICE OF CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION (CLASS 3) PRECISE DEVELOPMENT PLAN NO. 2012
  Doug Dooley ("Applicant"); 14411 Pontlavoy Avenue ("Subject Property"), also known as Assessor’s
  Parcel Numbers (APNs) 8070-018-031 and 8070-018-032; a request to reparcelize three (3) lots into
  two (2) substandard sized lots and construct two(2) new single-family dwellings on each lot.
  Staff Recommendation: That the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. 19-35 to approve
  Precise Development Plan No. 2012 subject to the conditions of approval contained in Exhibit "A".

  PDP 2012 report

  3.  NOTICE OF CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION (CLASS 11) SIGN USE PERMIT NO. 312
  Brian Leung of Kimley-Horn ("Applicant") on behalf of Target Corporation; 10600-10716 Firestone
  Boulevard ("Subject Property"), also known as Assessor’s Parcel Numbers ("APN") 8021-003-009,
  010, 011 and 8021-004-008 and 009; a request to update a master sign plan for an existing multi-
  tenant commercial development.
  Staff Recommendation: That the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. 19-36 to approve Sign
  Use Permit No. 312 subject to the conditions of approval contained in Exhibit "A".

  SUP 312 report

  4.  NOTICE OF CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION (CLASS 1) TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 82196
  Sarah Bova, Thienes Engineering, Inc. ("Applicant"); 15519-15537 Blackburn Avenue ("subject site"); a
  request to convert and subdivide two (2) existing industrial buildings into industrial condominium
  buildings, resulting in eight (8) sellable condominium units.
  Staff Recommendation: That the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. 19-37 to approve
  Tentative Tract Map No. 82196 subject to the conditions of approval contained in Exhibit "A".

  TTM 82196 report

  5.  NEGATIVE DECLARATION - STREET VACATION NO. 88 GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 182
  ZONE CHANGE NO. 361
  SIGN USE PERMIT NO. 315
  DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT
  Evergreen Media, LLC. ("Applicant"); location of the proposed development is a portion of Firestone
  Boulevard (previously used as street right-of-way), located adjacent to the Firestone Boulevard cul-de-
  sac south of Rosecrans Avenue ("project site"); a request to allow the construction of an off-premise,
  digital billboard sign on a City-owned property, including:

  1.  Vacate a portion of former Firestone Boulevard right-of-way for other City purposes;

  2.  Designate the project site as General Commercial in the City’s General Plan;

  3.  Designate the project site as General Commercial (“C-3”) zone in the City’s Zoning Map;

  4.  Allow the construction of an approximately 80-foot tall, off-premise digital billboard sign containing
  two (2) screens; and

  5.  Approve a development agreement between the City and the Applicant to establish an easement
  and allow the construction of a digital billboard on a City owned property. Staff Recommendation:
  That the Planning Commission:

  1.  Adopt Resolution No. 19-38 recommending City Council approval of Street Vacation No. 88;
   2.  Adopt Resolution No. 19-39 recommending City Council approval of General Plan
  Amendment No. 182 and adoption of the Negative Declaration;

  3.  Adopt Resolution No. 19-40 recommending City Council approval of Zone Change No. 361;

  4.  Adopt Resolution No. 19-41 to approve Sign Use Permit No. 315, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval contained in respective Exhibit "A"; and

  5.  Adopt Resolution No. 19-42 recommending City Council approval of a Development
  Agreement.

  Billboard Report

  NEW BUSINESS

  6. NOTICE OF EXEMPTION (GENERAL RULE) NORWALK PLANNING RESOLUTION NO. 19-
  43
  A resolution of the Planning Commission of the City of Norwalk confirming findings that the
  acquisition of 11950 Foster Road ("Subject Property") also known as Assessor’s Parcel
  Number 8054-016-020, ("Subject Property) is consistent with the General Plan.
  Staff Recommendation: That the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. 19-43
  recommending City Council approval of the acquisition of Assessor Parcel Number 8054-
  016-020, located at 11950 Foster Road, Norwalk, CA 90650, and finding that this action is
  consistent with the General Plan.

  Norwalk Planning Reso 19-43 report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated November 8, 2019.

John P. Ramirez, AICP
Director of Community Development/Secretary
